fine.note: The mutual 1x fees liability cap in MSA 13.2 matches the playbook standard.
IP ownership vests in the Client only upon payment, and AtliQ retains ownership of its pre-existing tools as required.
MSA 6.3 ensures AtliQ is paid for all work performed up to the termination date, including work in progress.
The confidentiality obligations are mutual and have a standard three-year survival period.
SOW 6 provides a clear 7-day review period with a deemed acceptance mechanism.
The agreement includes standard compliance with Indian data protection laws, including the DPDPA 2023.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to a reasonable six-month period.
The mutual indemnities are capped and cover appropriate categories like IP and confidentiality.
